newsitem.title: USA: One Price Clothing Q2 sales fall two pct.
newsitem.headline: One Price Clothing Q2 sales fall two pct.

text.p: One Price Clothing Stores Inc on Wednesday reported fiscal second quarter sales ended August 2 of of $86.1 million, off two percent from the year ago's $87.4 million. Same store sales for the period also fell two percent.

The company had 652 stores in operation at the end of the second quarter, compared with 663 stores in operation a year ago. Chain-wide average store sales rose two percent in the second quarter of fiscal 1997 compared with the second quarter of fiscal 1996.
